Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator. Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead. Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer. YOUR IMPACT As a microwave design engineer, you will help build the basis for the millimeter wave hardware acting as the spark plug that initiates a fusion plasma and raises its temperature to greater than 100 million degrees. You’ll join the Alpha Heating System team ready to drive the integrated RF and thermo-mechanical design of high-power components, and help build and test these components in the lab before installing them at scale on our net scientific gain Alpha stellarator. WHAT YOU WILL DO Provide innovative solutions to complex RF engineering challenges by collaborating closely with physicists to ensure component designs meet the Alpha plasma physics and thermal-mechanical constraints. Develop designs and evaluate vendor designs to determine an optimal path to efficiently deliver our power to the stellarator - driving down the denominator of input power that will limit fusion power plant gain Q=Pout/Pin - and drive down costs. Draw from and contribute to our stellarator development process, interfacing your RF components with other stellarator systems. Contribute to mechanical and thermal analysis and sensitivity studies for component viability under the loads and stresses imposed by the combination of vacuum, magnetic fields, temperatures, and MW-scale RF loads. Interface with the Alpha project management teams to realize the delivery of RF components and meet the tight Proxima timelines. WHO YOU ARE A highly capable RF engineer with experience in millimeter waves and knowledge of the tools and best practices for design of these systems Demonstrated familiarly with RF modeling codes - SURF3D, CST, COMSOL, GdfidL, openEMS, even self-developed python codes or ones plasma physics community hasn’t heard of - capable of performing modeling at 200 GHz frequencies Experience validating first-of-a-kind designs with uncertain performance, working as part of a team on multi-scale and multi-physics simulations, testing, and prototyping. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively. Experience with gyrotrons and associated components - transmission systems, launcher antennas, rf loads; experience with plasma physics is a plus. Understanding of quasi optical propagation of millimeter waves; ray tracing and where it breaks down INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) *This role sits at "L2-L3" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information. At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Electronics Design Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineer to play a pivotal role in bringing our groundbreaking EV products to market. As an NPI Engineer, you will be the central figure industrializing our developments together with our engineering team, suppliers, and contract manufacturers. 

Beyond traditional hardware ramp-up, this role is critical in building the "digital thread" of our serial production. You will be responsible for ensuring that as we scale quantities, our data remains structured, traceable, and ready for deep analytical insight. 


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Electrical System Architecture, Design, and Validation of Electric Powertrains

  • Define systems and component requirements in collaboration with the project management team

  • Conducting full PCBA development cycle: Design, Coordinating Manufacturing Process, Bring up, Verification, and Validation of PCBs

  • Collaboration with our firmware engineering team across all processes

  • Schematic design for BMS and charger updates, including bug fixes

  • Schematic design for a combined testing platform charger-battery

  • Design of battery simulation testbench

  • Final PCB implementation with supervision of BMS and charger

  • Defining subsystem-level test plans

  • Following test plans



What you bring to the team:

  • Ability to work from our offices in Munich, Germany

  • Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related fields

  • At least three years of experience in the field

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills

  • Experience in PCB design is a must

  • Hands-on experience in an electronic lab environment is a must

  • Understanding of power electronics systems

  • Understanding of embedded firmware infrastructure

  • Experience with compliance testing and EMC

  • A structured approach to work and project management experience

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal

  • German language skills are welcome

     

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

  • Mobility Benefit: With our mobility budget, we pay your “Germany Ticket” for work or personal use monthly. 

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities. 

  • Language Courses: German isn’t your mother tongue? We sponsor German courses for you to quickly learn and integrate even more. 

 

Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Buchhalter (m/w/x)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Finanzbereichs suchen wir Dich als erfahrenen Senior Buchhalter (m/w/d), der nicht nur fachlich sicher im Rechnungswesen ist, sondern auch mit einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität aktiv im Tagesgeschäft mitarbeitet. Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung in der operativen Buchhaltung und bringst Dein Know-how in die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Abläufen ein. Perspektivisch ist vorgesehen, dass Du im nächsten Schritt die fachliche Verantwortung für unser dreiköpfiges Team im Rechnungswesen übernimmst und damit eine wichtige Schlüsselrolle in unserem Finanzbereich einnimmst.


  • Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung der laufenden Finanzbuchhaltung nach HGB, insbesondere in den Bereichen Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Anlagen- und Hauptbuchhaltung

  • Mitarbeit bei der termingerechten Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB

  • Durchführung von Kontenabstimmungen sowie Klärung und Buchung von Sachverhalten im Hauptbuch

  • Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Auswertungen, Reports und betriebswirtschaftlichen Analysen für die Geschäftsführung und Fachbereiche

  • Mitwirkung bei der Liquiditätsplanung sowie Unterstützung im Zahlungsverkehr und Mahnwesen

  • Sicherstellung einer ordnungsgemäßen Buchführung unter Einhaltung gesetzlicher, steuerlicher und interner Vorgaben

  • Ansprechpartner für buchhalterische Fragestellungen innerhalb des Unternehmens sowie für Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer und externe Dienstleister

  • Mitwirkung bei steuerlich relevanten Themen, insbesondere im Bereich Umsatzsteuer, in Abstimmung mit externen Beratern

  • Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von buchhalterischen Prozessen, Richtlinien und internen Kontrollen

  • Mitarbeit an Projekten im Finanzbereich, z. B. bei der Digitalisierung, ERP-Weiterentwicklung oder der Optimierung von Reporting-Strukturen

  • Je nach Teamstruktur fachliche Unterstützung und Anleitung von Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Rechnungswesen

Fachliche Anforderungen: 

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK) oder abgeschlossenes betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen/Finanzen oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung, idealerweise in einem mittelständischen Unternehmen

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im HGB sowie fundierte Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen

  • Gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Anlagen- und Hauptbuchhaltung

  • Sicherer Umgang mit ERP-Systemen, idealerweise SAP R/3, sowie sehr gute MS-Excel-Kenntnisse; Erfahrung mit BI-Tools von Vorteil

  • Gute Kenntnisse in umsatzsteuerlichen Fragestellungen; weitere steuerliche Kenntnisse von Vorteil

  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Zuverlässigkeit

  • Hands-on-Mentalität und Freude an der operativen Mitarbeit im Tagesgeschäft

  • Analytisches Denkvermögen sowie Affinität zu Zahlen, Prozessen und Systemen

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

 

Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Steuerberater (m/w/d) in Unna, auf Wunsch mit Partnerperspektive, gesucht - mindestens 90.000€
jobs.descriptionHtml:
TaxTalente ist die Nr. 1 Job-Matching Plattform für Jobsuchende in der Steuerberatung.

Sie suchen eine positive berufliche Veränderung? Sie möchten den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere gehen und streben möglicherweise sogar eine Partnerschaft in einer zukunftsorientierten Kanzlei an? Sie möchten endlich wieder in einem positiven Arbeitsumfeld arbeiten, in dem Sie finanziell und persönlich wertgeschätzt werden? Sie suchen nach Tätigkeiten, die Sie auch wirklich weiterbringen?

Sofern Sie sich in mindestens einem der genannten Punkte wiederfinden, sollten Sie sich bei uns melden. Wir haben die attraktivsten Arbeitgeber der Steuerberatungsbranche in unserem Netzwerk und bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Grenzenlose Entwicklungschancen mit Partnermöglichkeiten, vielschichtige Tätigkeitsbereiche, Gehälter wie in der Industrie und vieles mehr – melden Sie sich bei uns und wir unterstützen Sie auf Ihrem weiteren Karriereweg!

Derzeit suchen wir nach einem Steuerberater (m/w/d) für eine unserer Partner-Kanzleien in Unna

Bei Rückfragen kannst du dich gerne jederzeit (auch nach deinem Feierabend) direkt telefonisch an Herrn Becker-Koch über folgende Nummer wenden: 015901431130

Aufgaben

Wir bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Dabei spielt das passende Tätigkeitsprofil natürlich eine entscheidende Rolle. Bei unserer Partnerkanzlei können Sie sich Ihren Aufgabenbereich auf Basis Ihrer persönlichen Stärken und Schwächen selbst zusammenstellen.

  • Erstellung und Review von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Erstellung von Steuererklärungen für Personen- und Kapitalgesellschaften
  • Steuerliche Sonderberatungsprojekte auf Basis individueller QualifikationenB. in den Bereichen der Erbschaftsteuer oder des Umwandlungssteuerrechts
  • Begleitung von Betriebsprüfungen
  • Teamleitung und Personalverantwortung (optional)
  • Weitere individuell wählbare Tätigkeitsbereiche, die Ihnen Freude bringen

Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn Sie sich in den folgenden Punkten wiederfinden.

  • Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
  • Führungsverständnis und Verantwortungsbewusstsein gegenüber Mitarbeitern (optional)
  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Steuerberaterexamen
  • Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Sie haben genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen Sie nicht wirklich profitieren? Dann sollten Sie einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

  • Außerordentliche Vergütung von 90.000 € bis 130.000 € / Jahr, auf Wunsch auch Partnerperspektive
  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf Home-Office
  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
  • Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen wie z.B. Fachberater Qualifikationen
  • Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient Ihren Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an Sie, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. lhre Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

  • Sie führen keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche mehr, bei denen Sie während des Bewerbungsprozesses merken, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor Ihrem Bewerbungsgespräch all Ihre mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab.
  • Wir führen Ihre Gehaltsverhandlungen und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens.

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.descriptionHtml: <h3> </h3> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>The role of an Accountant at Canonical:</strong></h3> <p>If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and advance your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas and truly contribute to a highly productive team. </p> <p>We are looking for an exceptional Accountant with IFRS experience to help us ready the business for public market scrutiny through our planned IPO.  The right candidate will have domain expertise and a passion for IFRS.  </p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role may be office based in London, or Remote in EMEA Time Zones. </p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Assist in the month end reporting process to deliver timely and accurate information</li> <li>Have full responsibility for a part of the ledger processes relevant to your strengths</li> <li>Assist with the year end audit process and statutory reporting</li> <li>Support the finance team's wider plans to prepare for an IPO</li> <li>Improve the efficiency of financial processes and procedures and monitor compliance</li> <li>Share knowledge between team members to ensure cover is available when needed</li> <li>Actively develop your own skills to ensure current knowledge of applicable standards and regulations</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with key colleagues outside the wider finance team</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record and subsequent career performance</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent</li> <li>Qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA, ACMA, CPA, etc.)</li> <li>Experience at a large public accounting firm, or public multinational corporate accounting department preferred</li> <li>NetSuite or similar enterprise grade systems experience</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to four times per year</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3> </h3>

jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>The role of an Accounts Payable Clerk at Canonical</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Accounts Payable Clerk to join our growing team. If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and kick start your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, truly motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. As the publisher of Ubuntu and a leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, Canonical works across a broad partner ecosystem that includes global system integrators, value-added resellers, regional distributors, independent software vendors, independent hardware vendors, silicon companies, public clouds and other strategic technology brands.</p> <p>These partners shape the platforms, solutions, marketplaces, hardware and delivery motions through which enterprises adopt open source at scale. We are looking for exceptional partner leaders who can build durable, mutually valuable relationships, develop joint solutions, drive global go-to-market programmes, and convert partner potential into measurable customer impact, revenue growth and market expansion for Canonical.</p> <p>Opportunities are available for both people leaders and senior individual contributors. In these roles, you will lead, build or scale one or more strategic partner motions for Canonical, either by managing a team or by directly driving high-impact partner initiatives. You will work closely with partners throughout their sales, product, delivery and executive planning cycles to make Canonical their trusted partner for enterprise open source solutions. Depending on your experience and Canonical’s business priorities, your focus may include Channels, GSI, ISV, IHV/OEM, Silicon, Cloud or cross-ecosystem partnerships.</p> <p>Our Alliances and Channels teams build trusted relationships with partners at executive level, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelise the partnership, and lead business interactions from engineers to CxO level. This role will own strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions across assigned partners or sectors, as well as promotion of partner-related activities, from campaigns, enablement and executive engagement, to strategic opportunities and partner events.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>These are globally remote positions.</p> <p><strong>The role entails</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and drive partner strategy, forecast, bookings and revenues for Canonical across one or more indirect routes to market</li> <li>Lead and evolve a team or strategic partner portfolio towards partners, sales, product management, product marketing and engineering teams</li> <li>Develop partner capability through sales engagement, technical enablement, joint marketing and disciplined business planning</li> <li>Guide our offering from product management, to product marketing, and scale it through the support of our global sales organisation</li> <li>Establish operating cadence, pipeline governance and data-driven accountability across complex partner relationships</li> </ul> <p>What we are looking for in you:</p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in alliance, channel, partner, ecosystem or indirect sales management roles</li> <li>Experience in one or more of GSIs, VARs, distributors, ISVs, IHVs/OEMs, silicon, public cloud, marketplaces or strategic technology alliances</li> <li>Deep commercial experience encompassing revenue, margins, pipeline, forecasting and partner economics</li> <li>Proven leadership and presentation skills, with the ability to engage confidently from engineer to CxO level</li> <li>Ability to build trusted executive relationships while aligning product, sales, marketing, engineering and operations teams</li> <li>Insight into open source, Ubuntu, enterprise infrastructure, cloud, AI, security and Canonical’s competition and opportunities</li> <li>Track record of data-driven decision-making and disciplined execution across complex, global relationships</li> <li>An autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.</li> <li>Business level written and spoken English.</li> <li>Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.</li> <li>International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <p>In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</p> <ul> <li>Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.</li> <li>Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</li> <li>Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.</li> <li>Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</li> </ul> jobs.title: Alliances Field Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an <strong>Alliances Field Engineer</strong> to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.</p> <p>Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.</p> <p>We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.</p> <p>We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments</li> <li>Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)</li> <li>Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX</li> <li>Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical’s technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center</li> <li>Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners</li> <li>Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners’ teams to promote Canonical products and solutions</li> </ul> <p>If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Engineer role at Canonical.</p> <h3>What we are looking for in you </h3> <ul> <li>Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds</li> <li>Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills</li> <li>Fluent written and spoken English</li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills</li> <li>High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments</li> <li>Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs</li> <li>Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps</li> <li>Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time</li> <li>Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related technical field experience</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p> </p>

This role is an opportunity for a hands-on engineer with eagerness to learn, a passion for Linux and open source technologies to work with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.</p> <p>We regularly solve interesting, technical problems. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. jobs.title: Communications Lead, Wikimedia Enterprise (Contract)
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>COMMUNICATIONS LEAD, WIKIMEDIA ENTERPRISE (CONTRACT)</strong></p> <p><strong>Contract terms:</strong> 40 hours/week, initial 6-month contract, with potential to extend based on organizational needs</p> <p><strong>Reports to: </strong>Communications Manager (dotted line to President of Wikimedia Enterprise)</p> <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our mission is to bring free educational content to the world.</p> <p>Wikimedia Enterprise is the Wikimedia Foundation's commercial product for large-scale reusers and distributors of Wikimedia content. Through Enterprise agreements, companies gain improved, commercial-grade access to Wikimedia content at a volume and scale they need,  while directly supporting the Wikimedia Foundation's free knowledge mission. As AI systems increasingly scrape Wikipedia at scale, Wikimedia Enterprise has become critical to a sustainable model for Wikimedia projects and the open knowledge ecosystem.</p> <p>We're looking for an experienced communications lead to serve as the primary communications partner to the Wikimedia Enterprise team — shaping external messaging, media relations, and thought leadership to drive organic demand for Wikimedia Enterprise services, while ensuring narrative and strategic alignment with the Foundation's broader communications priorities.  This role sits in the Media Relations team, within the Foundation’s <a href="https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation/Communications">Communications Department</a>, with a dotted line to the President of Wikimedia Enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and own the external communications strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across media/trade press, speaking engagements, and other channels that build visibility and organic demand for Enterprise offerings.</li> <li>Build relationships with reporters (mainstream and B2B tech trade press) and conference organizers to secure speaking opportunities and position Wikimedia Enterprise as the go-to product for commercial content reusers.</li> <li>Serve as a primary media liaison for Wikimedia Enterprise, working with the wider media relations team to manage daily press inquiries, prepping spokespeople/staffing interviews, information requests, and speaking engagement requests in a timely manner. This includes leading rapid response media efforts — triaging sensitive, fast-moving situations with sound judgment.</li> <li>Partner with internal teams to develop narratives and thought leadership that strengthens Wikimedia Enterprise's brand relevance and positioning.</li> <li>Guide, produce, and review marketing and communications materials — press statements, blogs, pitch notes and lists, briefing docs, and more — ensuring key messages about Wikimedia Enterprise are shaped consistently and clearly for public audiences.</li> <li>Coordinate  the end-to-end communications workflow for major external launches and announcements together with the Enterprise Growth team, from drafting through internal review, stakeholder approvals, and release.</li> <li>Ensure alignment between the Wikimedia Enterprise growth plan and the Foundation's annual communications calendar.</li> <li>Build relationships and lead cooperative efforts with internal and external stakeholders — Wikimedia Foundation colleagues, Wikimedia volunteers and affiliates, and external partners — to enable the successful delivery of communications plans.</li> <li>Manage relationships with external vendors (such as PR agencies) as directed to deliver on goals.</li> <li>Use data and customer insights to refine messaging, content, and strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across business audiences.</li> <li>Work with leadership to set goals and KPIs for Wikimedia Enterprise communications, track results against the growth plan, and share actionable insights with leadership and key stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least 8+ years of communications experience, including experience operating at a senior/lead level with minimal oversight in a tech and/or B2B tech environment or supporting a commercial product line.</li> <li>Proven experience bridging communications and marketing/growth functions — ideally in a role that required translating between brand/editorial priorities and commercial or growth objectives.</li> <li>Experience with developing and executing earned media strategy and thought leadership, building relationships with press, partners, and wider stakeholders to develop a pipeline of coverage across channels and platforms.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management skills, including experience influencing senior and executive stakeholders, with a track record of working effectively across teams with different priorities, cultures, and reporting lines.</li> <li>Sound judgment on reputational risk and sensitivity, particularly when balancing commercial messaging against mission-driven or community-facing considerations.</li> <li>Comfortable operating with ambiguity, with the ability to ramp up quickly and take ownership of a live workflow with minimal onboarding, given the fixed-term nature of this role.</li> <li>Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt tone across formats — from press materials to marketing copy to internal briefing documents.</li> <li>Strong editorial judgment: demonstrable ability to review and shape marketing materials (campaigns, web copy, social, blogs, thought leadership) for voice, tone, and brand consistency.</li> <li>A track record of tying communications to business results: setting metrics, measuring impact (coverage quality, share of voice, inbound demand, pipeline influence) and changing course based on the data.</li> <li>Experience working in a matrixed organization, comfortable with dotted-line jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a Community Management Associate to engage online communities, help refine our brand voice, and build a vibrant, Gen Z-focused social media presence for Wikipedia and the Wikimedia Foundation.</p> <p>Sitting on the Social Team within External Communications, you will bring energy and creativity to how we show up across platforms. From writing engaging comment copy and jumping on real-time cultural moments to surfacing stories from our global volunteer community, you will help connect Wikipedia with next-generation internet audiences.</p> <p>This is a fast-moving, hands-on role perfect for someone who lives on social media, loves online culture, and is eager to test and learn. Preferred working time zones are UTC -8 to UTC -5 (Mexico, Columbia, Canada and United States)</p> <p><strong>Ideally You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>A Digital Culture Native:</strong> Plugged into emerging trends and short-form video culture (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) with a natural feel for Gen Z engagement.</li> <li><strong>A Strong Communicator:</strong> Experienced in writing social comment copy and adapting brand tone across different platforms.</li> <li><strong>An Organized Framework Builder:</strong> Eager to help draft clear community playbooks, response protocols, and engagement guidelines.</li> <li><strong>A Community Connector:</strong> Excited to interact directly with followers and surface stories from our global volunteer network.</li> <li><strong>A Data-Aware Learner:</strong> Comfortable reviewing basic analytics and social listening insights to refine engagement tactics.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Community Engagement & Copywriting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assist in writing daily social copy, managing comment sections, and executing reactive engagement on trending moments.</li> <li>Support the development and documentation of community management playbooks and brand tone-of-voice guidelines.</li> <li>Help identify, surface, and share inspiring stories from Wikipedia’s global volunteer community.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Trends & Growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Track short-form video trends, platform updates, and emerging formats to recommend fresh engagement opportunities.</li> <li>Support testing of social listening and moderation tools to improve community response time.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tracking & Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor channel activity, track audience sentiment, and assist with monthly performance reporting.</li> <li>Participate in creative experimentation to see which copy and engagement styles resonate best.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>1–3 years</strong> of hands-on experience in social media execution, community management, or digital storytelling.</li> <li><strong>Short-Form Native:</strong> Active familiarity with TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.</li> <li><strong>Writing & Moderation:</strong> Experience writing social copy, engaging in comment sections, or moderating online channels.</li> <li><strong>Basic Tool Familiarity:</strong> Exposure to social management, analytics, or listening tools.</li> <li><strong>Good Judgment:</strong> High emotional intelligence to navigate sensitive comments and know when to escalate risks.</li> <li><strong>Global Mindset:</strong> Awareness of cross-cultural nuances and working with diverse global audiences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualities That Matter to Us</strong></p> <ul> <li>Passion for the Wikimedia mission and free knowledge.</li> <li>Flexibility working with distributed teams across time zones.</li> <li>A collaborative spirit, curiosity, and a real love for internet culture.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive. </p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.</p> <p><em><strong>As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.</strong></em></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries<strong>*</strong>. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$62,074 to US$93,077 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.</p> <p><strong>*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:</strong><br><strong>US States</strong>: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)</p> <p><strong>For US-based applicants: this position is part of the Communication Workers of America bargaining unit.</strong><br><br><strong>Countries: </strong>Brazil, Canada, Colombia, France, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>HEAD OF MARKETING</strong></p> <p><strong>Reports to: Senior Director of External Communications</strong></p> <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for an experienced Head of Marketing to help establish and oversee a new function responsible for product and integrated marketing. </p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the non-profit that hosts Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects. Product marketing is a new function being established at the Foundation, and the Head of Marketing will help build it from the ground up. They will bring our existing integrated marketing work together with this new capability into one unified function that will help ensure Wikipedia remains visible and relevant to generations of readers around the world.</p> <p>Positioned within the External Communications team, this senior manager level role will collaborate with Foundation stakeholders to shape our go-to-market approach. While the primary audience focus for the role is readers, they will also help develop a unified view of audience engagement across the Foundation’s external audiences.</p> <p>This role is remote and open to candidates across UTC+2 to UTC-4 (Central European through Eastern Time). Given the globally distributed nature of the team and role requirements, flexibility outside standard hours should be expected.</p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities will include: </strong></p> <p><strong>Product marketing leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with the Senior Director of External Communications to help establish product marketing as an emerging function, developing the processes and go-to-market approach needed to engage new external audiences.</li> <li>Recruit and lead team members overseeing product marketing, ensuring alignment with strategy and organisational needs.</li> <li>Lead coordination with Foundation departments to establish a shared approach to external audience engagement, and campaign planning.</li> <li>Bring a retention and lifetime-engagement lens to product marketing planning.</li> <li>Develop a foundation for product marketing metrics including audience growth, campaign impact, adoption/retention improvement, stronger brand awareness, or clearer GTM process.</li> <li>Establish strong commercial judgement within the audience and competitive landscape, able to identify and prioritise market needs and balance that with corresponding product features.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Brand and channel marketing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with the Brand Studio and Brand Management team to develop a shared global brand marketing approach. </li> <li>Line-manage team members responsible for integrated and performance marketing, including paid media and owned digital experiences.</li> <li>Collaborate with Insights and Brand Studio on developing new marketing briefs, staffing for new projects, and development of campaigns and activations that grow global brand visibility, likeability, and awareness.</li> <li>Ensure strategic alignment between the briefs product marketing produces and how the wider marketing and communications team adopts them.</li> <li>Oversee the development and execution of the Foundation's web, SEO/GEO, and app store strategy as core organic growth channels. </li> <li>Architect and oversee decisions on marketing technology and tooling, ensuring seamless data integration between CRM platforms, martech systems, product analytics tools, and communication channels.</li> <li>Stay at the forefront of trends, platform shifts, emerging channels, and marketing tools. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Team leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leading and line managing a multidisciplinary marketing team.</li> <li>Actively managing priorities across the dual remit of product marketing and integrated marketing, ensuring sufficient attention is directed to both.</li> <li>Overseeing and managing relationships with external agencies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years of marketing experience, including significant knowledge of product marketing (at least 5 years in a b2c setting), and line management of multi-disciplinary teams.</li> <li>Experience at a major website, online publisher/platform, growing and engaging audiences at scale globally.</li> <li>Experience building product messaging and value propositions, with global audience segmentation and lifecycle marketing experience.</li> <li>Ability to adapt tone, voice, and message across different cultural contexts.</li> <li>Experience in agile, fast-paced, complex, and ambiguous marketing environments, comfortable balancing both a hands on and strategic approach, while handling long-term strategy building with short-term performance demands.</li> <li>Experience in leading through influence and collaboration to drive alignment across teams and departments. </li> <li>Experience developing and overseeing a multichannel strategy across paid, owned, and earned media.</li> <li>Ability to operate as a peer with internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience with campaign analytics, with the ability to translate data into shared strategic decisions.</li> <li>Direct experience evaluating or implementing marketing technology, such as CRM or audience and campaign data platforms.</li> <li>Experience working remotely and across multiple time zones and emerging markets, including leading a distributed team.</li> <li>Budget management experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We’d also love it if you have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Curiosity and enthusiasm for the Wikimedia mission.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive. </p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.</p> <p><em><strong>As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.</strong></em></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries<strong>*</strong>. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. jobs.title: Lead Financial Analyst, Strategic Business Partner – Product & Technology
jobs.descriptionHtml: <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Summary</strong></span></h2> <p>Join the Foundation in our ambitious project to empower people to create and share the sum of all human knowledge. We are looking for a Lead Financial Analyst to serve as the strategic business partner to our Product & Technology department, one of the most dynamic and fastest-growing parts of the organization, with a combined budget of more than $100M. You will also support other key areas of our work and, as the most senior analyst on the Financial Business Partner team, be responsible for driving improvements in financial planning, analytics, and our business partnership practices.</p> <p>This is a business partnering role first and an FP&A role second. You will sit alongside product and engineering leaders, help them weigh investment tradeoffs before decisions are made, and turn roadmaps into financial plans. You will work directly with the Chief of Product and Technology (CPTO), the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), and the broader executive team. This is a chance to have an outsized impact on a mission-driven organization that operates one of the most visited websites in the world.</p> <p>This role is remote and open to candidates between UTC-8 and UTC+1.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Why this role</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>Be the trusted finance advisor to Product & Technology leadership, with a real voice in how we invest more than $100M in people, infrastructure, and partners.</li> <li>Work on infrastructure that serves more than 20 billion views per month.</li> <li>Drive projects with impact and executive visibility, including our CPTO and CFO.</li> <li>Shape the future of our business partner function by leading projects, setting standards, and mentoring other analysts.</li> <li>Join a collaborative, globally distributed team that values knowledge sharing.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you'll do</strong></span></h2> <p><strong>Be the Finance Partner to Product & Technology, and a second department</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the lead finance partner to department leaders and budget owners, providing analysis that informs prioritization and investment trade-offs.</li> <li>Join planning and roadmap conversations early as the voice of finance, raising tradeoffs and risks before commitments are made.</li> <li>Provide the financial voice in business strategy across our technical infrastructure and product development objectives.</li> <li>Translate roadmaps from teams like SRE, AI/ML, and Data Engineering into budgets, forecasts, and headcount and contractor plans.</li> <li>Lead annual budgeting, quarterly reforecasting, and multi-year planning for your departments.</li> <li>Facilitate on vendor spend optimization across cloud, hosting, software, and contractor support.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Plan for capital and technical accounting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead data center and infrastructure CAPEX planning, including capacity, hardware refresh, and depreciation impacts.</li> <li>Partner with Accounting on software capitalization, including project classification and capitalizable labor and contractor costs.</li> <li>Model total cost of ownership and build-versus-buy decisions, and communicate their financial impact clearly to non-finance leaders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Deliver insight and reporting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead month-end close, forecasting, and variance analysis, with clear commentary on drivers, risks, and opportunities.</li> <li>Present resource plans and financial performance to senior leaders, including our CPTO and CFO.</li> <li>Build and maintain dashboards that connect spend to technical and product outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lead, mentor, and strengthen the business partner function</strong></p> <ul> <li>Coach and mentor FP&A analysts on modeling, analysis, and stakeholder partnership, including reviewing their work and helping them build executive-ready communication.</li> <li>Help set the standard for what good financial business partnership looks like, and share best practices across the team.</li> <li>Lead projects that improve the function, from scoping through roll-out, including streamlining multi-year financial modeling, departmental reporting, and business insights.</li> <li>Help manage our financial planning and reporting system, including documentation, process improvements, and new module roll-outs.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you'll bring</strong></span></h2> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree plus 7+ years of experience in FP&A, financial business partnering, or corporate finance, including experience supporting a technology, engineering, or product organization. MBA or CPA preferred.</li> <li>Experience partnering with technical and product teams, and the curiosity to learn how they work.</li> <li>Experience working at a strategic level on business and organizational-wide goals.</li> <li>Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, and excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting to executives.</li> <li>A track record of building credibility with senior stakeholders and influencing without authority.</li> <li>Experience supporting multiple divisions or business units at once, mentoring or coaching other analysts, and leading process improvement projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tech-specific planning experience, such as data center or infrastructure CAPEX, software capitalization (ASC 350-40), headcount planning, and contractor or vendor spend.</li> <li>Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning.</li> <li>Finance business intelligence and reporting experience.</li> <li>Experience in a nonprofit, open-source, or mission-driven organization.</li> <li>An understanding of the free culture, free software, or online rights movements.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Qualities that are important to us</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>You love solving problems and understand the connections between micro decisions and the macro systems.</li> <li>You love deeply understanding business drivers and finding ways we can deploy resources for greater impact. </li> <li>You believe in the mission and enjoy collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders.</li> <li>You work well with distributed teams, both asynchronously and synchronously.</li> <li>You are proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and adaptable in a fast-changing environment.</li> <li>You look for ways to simplify and standardize, and you can bring others along.</li> <li>You are a thoughtful mentor who enjoys raising the capability of those around you.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <ul> <li>Product & Technology leaders involve you early and treat you as a thought partner, not a scorekeeper.</li> <li>Investment proposals arrive with clear, well-supported financial cases.</li> <li>Budgets and forecasts reflect the real roadmap, and variance commentary explains the why.</li> <li>FP&A analysts on the team are growing in skill and confidence through your coaching.</li> <li>The business partner function has stronger standards, tools, and processes than it did before you joined.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Travel Expectations:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Frequency:</strong> 2–3 trips per year (international and domestic).</li> <li><strong>Purpose:</strong> Annual department offsite, strategy alignment with Product & Tech (P&T) leadership, and global community conferences.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia scoping through roll-out, including streamlining multi-year financial modeling, departmental reporting, and business insights.</li> <li>Help manage our financial planning and reporting system, including documentation, process improvements, and new module roll-outs.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you'll bring</strong></span></h2> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> organization. organizational-wide goals.</li> <li>Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, and excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting to executives.</li> <li>A track record of building credibility with senior stakeholders and influencing without authority.</li> <li>Experience supporting multiple divisions or business units at once, mentoring or coaching other analysts, and leading process improvement projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tech-specific planning experience, such as data center or infrastructure CAPEX, software capitalization (ASC 350-40), headcount planning, and contractor or vendor spend.</li> <li>Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning.</li> <li>Finance business intelligence and reporting experience.</li> <li>Experience in a nonprofit, open-source, or mission-driven organization.</li> <li>An understanding of the free culture, free software, or online rights movements.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: jobs.title: Lead Learning Experience Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a <strong>Lead Learning Experience Designer</strong> to create innovative, engaging, and accessible learning experiences that strengthen the capacity of volunteers and communities across the Wikimedia movement. You'll help contributors develop the confidence, skills, and knowledge they need to participate effectively, navigate Wikimedia’s communities and practices, and grow as contributors. </span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">In this role, you'll partner with Foundation teams, affiliates, researchers, subject matter experts, and volunteers to understand learner needs, identify barriers to participation, and develop learning experiences that support contributors at different stages of their journey. </span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">This role goes beyond traditional instructional design. You’ll think like a learning product designer, finding the right approach for each challenge, whether that means creating an online course on Wikimedia’s learning management system (LMS), WikiLearn, producing multimedia content, experimenting with emerging technologies, or embedding learning into existing experiences and workflows. You will do all this while ensuring the experiences you create are culturally responsive, accessible, and relevant to a global audience. This role is intended for an experienced individual who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and making decisions in complex, evolving environments.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Success in this role means being a curious, resourceful problem solver who understands how people learn, grow, and participate. You can think big about how learning can strengthen the Wikimedia movement, while also rolling up your sleeves to build, experiment, and iterate on solutions that make a meaningful difference. </span></p> <h4><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Design and develop innovative digital learning experiences, capacity-strengthening resources, and performance support solutions for contributors across the Wikimedia movement.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Partner with product teams, community groups, researchers, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs, contributor challenges, and opportunities to strengthen participation.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Determine the right learning approach for each opportunity, whether that be a self-paced course, video, interactive experience, feedback.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the Foundation's learning movement.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Ensure learning resources reflect Wikimedia's values of openness, collaboration, equity, and knowledge sharing.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Qualifications</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Required</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience designing and developing digital learning experiences for diverse, global audiences.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Demonstrated experience creating engaging e-learning, instructor-led, virtual, or blended learning solutions.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience using a learning management system (LMS) to develop, organize, and publish learning content.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Demonstrated ability to diagnose capability gaps, identify the right interventions, and rapidly design, build and improve learning experiences.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Excellent written communication and content development skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family:
